recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖，在母細胞閘（blast gate）中 CD34 對 CD117 作圖，71.02% 母細胞同時表現 CD34 與 CD117，顯示為未成熟骨髓系母細胞族群。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD34-PC7 (y-axis) versus CD117-APC (x-axis)
Dominant cluster in the upper-right quadrant: CD34+CD117+ 71.02%
Tight, relatively homogeneous population indicating a clonal immature myeloid blast population
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on the blast region displays CD34 versus CD117. The majority of gated events (71.02%) co-express CD34 and CD117 as a cohesive cluster, with smaller CD117-only (11.25%) and double-negative (14.47%) fractions. This indicates an immature myeloid blast population. Lineage assignment and aberrancies require the remaining panel, and the specific genetic subtype (inv(3)/t(3;3)) cannot be inferred from this plot alone.

ddx.vs: MPAL requires MPO or monocytic markers plus lineage-defining T (cytoplasmic CD3) or B markers, which are not assessed in this CD34/CD117 plot.
Lymphoblasts are CD34+ but typically CD117-negative, whereas this population is predominantly CD117-positive.
